releaseNotes:
Official Update v1.3.13:
- Dedicated Service Management: Consolidated all order type controls into Business Profile & Services with Walk-In as the first default option.
- Removed Duplicate Services Sub-Tab: POS Departments is now exclusively dedicated to category management, avoiding configuration conflicts.
- 1-Click Held Tickets Combine: Cashiers can seamlessly merge held orders into active carts alongside newly scanned items.
- Granular Loyalty Control: Disabling loyalty points completely hides reward points, QR autoregistration, and customer balances.
- Temporary Support PIN: Emergency PIN 9111 configured with dual expiration (10 uses or 48 hours) and live usage counter in Admin Settings.
- Clean virgin database setup with zero customer-specific data.
